method: Hand-tagged topic of the largest independent expenditures from the 24/48-hour notice PDF (source_url), which usually names the ad. Separate from the vendor/payment relationship. 2026-09-05 (devin-block2-issues): the 60 largest IEs in this race were inspected; every filed purpose line reads MEDIA BUY / MEDIA PLACEMENT / TV/MEDIA PLACEMENT / ONLINE ADVERTISING / DIGITAL AD BUY with no ad title or issue clue, and no purpose line across all 2,235 IEs names a topic, so no row was written. Tags are never inferred from the spender's name or its self-described focus.
